mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% indicates labor market weakness that triggers Fed accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining industrial production signals manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 600.0 thousand units signals housing sector contraction, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 600.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI increase and federal funds rate decline indicate inflationary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as growth concerns rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, declining real GDP growth signals potential double-dip recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during post-recession recovery when GDPC1 declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 in this regime.
